Plan

See VISION.md for the full research concept, methodology, and academic context.

Concept: Given a company name, product, or barcode — automatically map its complete supply chain using OSINT, infer hidden nodes with AI confidence scoring, flag violations, and produce EDRM-compliant evidence for regulatory enforcement.

Industry partner: Scania AB (ground truth validation) Goal: Multi-signal OSINT inference + EDRM evidence chain + EU regulatory output

Epics

Epics are ordered from very simple to advanced; each one ends in working software you can demo. Items keep their original IDs (A–G). Requirements are in docs/requirements.yml.

Epic 1: Static SupplyLens demo

Working software: The interactive dashboards (docs/*.html) run in a browser on the embedded Scania data: logistics risk, financial monitor, deep dive, chain diff, carbon, dual sourcing.

Demo: Open docs/supplier_deep_dive.html and docs/logistics_risk.html offline.

Requires: none (static files)

A2 — Evidence geo map docs/evidence_map.html - What: D3 world map, supplier pins at real lat/lon, supply chain arcs, click supplier → evidence sidebar (docs, claims, confidence, source) - Data: lat/lon already in cypher v8 for mines/logistics - Status: BUILT

A4 — EDRM pipeline tracker docs/edrm_tracker.html - What: per-supplier status grid — Scraped / Extracted / RAG-indexed / Reviewed - Shows: pipeline completeness %, next action per supplier - Status: BUILT

C2 — Logistics route risk src/logistics_risk.py - What: score Suez / Malacca / Trans-Sib routes by disruption probability - Which products halt, for how long, alt routes + cost premium - Status: BUILT (7 routes, per-supplier routing map, €456M rev-at-risk demo)

C3 — Financial monitoring script scripts/financial_monitor.py - What: weekly check — Z-score thresholds, covenant breach alerts - Write alerts to Neo4j, surface in dashboard - Status: BUILT (20 suppliers, Altman Z + ND/EBITDA + credit rating; FinancialAlert nodes)

D1 — Logistics Risk Dashboard docs/logistics_risk.html - 7 chokepoint routes (Suez/Malacca/Trans-Sib/Cape/Panama/Bosphorus/Hormuz) - D3 probability bars, scatter (Rev@Risk vs Delay, bubble=prob), supplier×route matrix - Status: BUILT

D2 — Financial Monitor Dashboard docs/financial_monitor.html - Altman Z-Score + ND/EBITDA D3 bars with zone thresholds (red 1.81 / yellow 2.99) - D3 scatter: Z vs ND/EBITDA, quadrant shading; CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM alert cards - Status: BUILT

D3 — Kotaemon RAG Search UI docs/kotaemon_search.html - Chat UI over 20 indexed supplier docs; citation display; 5 demo answers offline - Live health-check of CT120 (10.0.1.120:8501) every 30s; real API call if online - Status: BUILT

D4 — Cypher v10 — Autonomous Truck AI chain (appended to sample_graph.cypher) - SCANIA-AXL Level 4 autonomous truck product - T1: NVIDIA Corporation, Mobileye Global, Luminar Technologies (DISTRESS), Knorr-Bremse, HERE, Parker Hannifin - T2: TSMC (Taiwan risk), ARM Holdings (SINGLE_SOURCE), ASML (export controls), Synopsys, Cadence - T3: Shin-Etsu Chemical, JSR Corporation (EUV photoresist), Cryoin Engineering (Ukraine neon), Orano - RawMaterials: Silicon Wafers, EUV Photoresist, Neon Gas, Hafnium, Germanium (China export controls) - 17 events total (added NVIDIA export controls 2023, ASML China restriction, neon shortage 2022) - Status: BUILT

E1 — Chain Diff src/chain_diff.py + docs/chain_diff.html - Snapshot diff: new risk flags, Altman Z threshold crossings, tier changes, new suppliers - Visual diff dashboard: CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM severity filter, new nodes/relationships/events - Status: BUILT (commit b2c0978)

E2 — Supplier Deep Dive docs/supplier_deep_dive.html - Per-supplier comprehensive view: risk ring, financial bars, credit rating, events, logistics, evidence, compliance, alt suppliers - 9 suppliers embedded: ZF/CATL/TSMC/Norilsk/Luminar/Leoni/SSAB/JSR/Bosch - Status: BUILT (commit b2c0978)

F1 — Carbon & CBAM tracker src/carbon_tracker.py + docs/carbon_footprint.html - Scope 1/2/3 emissions for 12 Scania suppliers; CBAM certificate cost; SBTi on-track check; CDP scores - D3 bar chart: 5 modes (Scope1+2, Scope3, CO2 intensity, CBAM cost, YoY trend) - Sidebar: per-supplier scope bars + SBTi/CDP badges + CBAM detail - Status: BUILT (Phase 10)

F2 — Dual sourcing optimizer src/dual_sourcing.py + docs/dual_sourcing.html - 9 suppliers × all alternatives; risk-weighted priority score; budget slider (greedy knapsack) - Action tiers: IMMEDIATE/SHORT_TERM/MEDIUM_TERM/MONITOR - D3 scatter: Priority vs Qualification Cost (bubble = rev@risk) - Filter by action tier or single-source flag; per-supplier detail panel - Status: BUILT (Phase 10)

Epic 2: Live Scania graph

Working software: The Scania graph is seeded in Neo4j with evidence on every node, and the 3D graph and evidence map read it live instead of hard-coded data.

Demo: Click a supplier in docs/supplylens_3d.html; its evidence comes from Neo4j.

Requires: neo4j · seed via VPN or the public Neo4j endpoint

A1 — Evidence store src/evidence_store.py - What: every Neo4j node gets source_doc, source_excerpt, confidence properties - Functions: store_evidence(), get_evidence(), mark_reviewed() - CLI: python3 src/evidence_store.py get "Norilsk Nickel" - Status: BUILT (commit 3a2d19e)

G1 — Seed the Scania demo graph into Neo4j - What: run bash scripts/seed_scania.sh (loads example_outputs/sample_graph.cypher v10 into CT114) - Done when: MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) on CT114 matches the node count in the cypher file - Blocked by: bastion 10.0.0.16 and CT114 unreachable over VPN (infra D-3, see SCANIA_DEMO_STATUS.md) - Status: BLOCKED (needs VPN)

A3 — 3D graph live evidence (update docs/supplylens_3d.html) - What: pull evidence from Neo4j via SSH tunnel instead of hardcoded JS - Currently: evidence panel has hardcoded JS data - Status: PARTIALLY BUILT (hardcoded evidence only)

E3 — A3 live evidence in 3D graph (update docs/supplylens_3d.html) - Pull evidence from Neo4j via fetch instead of hardcoded JS - Status: PARTIALLY BUILT (hardcoded evidence only)

Epic 3: Automated mapping agent

Working software: POST /runs {"company": "Scania AB"} scrapes, extracts, retrieves cited evidence from Kotaemon, infers hidden suppliers and merges them into Neo4j.

Demo: Run the agent for one supplier; new nodes appear with citations and confidence.

Requires: langgraph, browserless, unstructured, tika, kotaemon, qdrant, litellm

B1 — Deploy Kotaemon CT120 - What: run bash scripts/provision_ct120.sh on cluster - Then: python3 scripts/ingest_kotaemon.py loads synthetic docs - Status: PARTIALLY BUILT — Kotaemon answers at kotaemon.research-ready.nl (inventory: CT129, port 7860, probed 2026-09-28); verify the synthetic docs are ingested

B2 — Citation extraction (update src/kotaemon_client.py) - What: parse [Source: doc_name, p.N] from Kotaemon answers - Write citations back to Neo4j node as evidence via evidence_store - Status: BUILT (commit c0e9f23)

B3 — Wire citations into pipeline (update src/agent.py) - What: call store_evidence() in merge node after each inferred fact - Result: every LLM-inferred supply chain link has a document citation - Status: BUILT (commit c0e9f23)

C1 — Cypher v9: event evidence links - What: each Event node gets source_doc + source_url properties - Add: Taiwan Strait risk, Red Sea Houthi events with citations - Status: BUILT (14 events, backfilled citations on all 12 existing, :AFFECTED_BY rel)

E5 — Point SupplyLens at Kotaemon on CT129 - Kotaemon runs on CT129:7860 (inventory), not CT120 (that is monitoring); update scripts/provision_ct120.sh, src/kotaemon_client.py and the D3 search UI health check (10.0.1.120:8501) - Then: python3 scripts/ingest_kotaemon.py loads the synthetic docs - Status: NOT BUILT

G2 — Deploy the SupplyLens agent on CT119 - What: serve src/agent.py as LangGraph POST /runs (scrape → extract → embed → infer → merge) - Done when: POST /runs {"company": "Scania AB"} adds or updates suppliers in Neo4j with evidence - Depends on: G1 - Status: NOT BUILT

Epic 4: Self-refreshing intelligence

Working software: A weekly n8n run refreshes the graph, syncs suppliers to PostgreSQL and updates the BI dashboards; the chain diff shows what changed.

Demo: After Monday’s run, the chain diff and Superset show the week’s changes.

Requires: n8n, postgres, superset or metabase

G3 — Activate the weekly n8n refresh - What: import config/n8n_workflow.json into n8n CT104; Monday 06:00 cron calls G2 - Done when: one scheduled execution finishes and the chain diff (E1) shows its changes - Depends on: G2 - Status: NOT BUILT

G4 — Schedule the PostgreSQL supplier sync - What: run src/postgres_sync.py after each refresh so Superset/Metabase can read knopenkonings.suppliers - Done when: supplier rows match Neo4j after a G3 run - Status: PARTIALLY BUILT (script exists, not scheduled)

G5 — Provision Superset dashboards - What: supplier count by country, tier pie, risk heatmap on CT206 (scripts/setup_superset.py) - Done when: the three charts load from knopenkonings.suppliers - Depends on: G4 - Status: NOT BUILT

Epic 5: Deliverables for Scania

Working software: Per-supplier scorecard PDFs and a validated graph, documented in the SupplyLens book.

Demo: Hand Scania a scorecard PDF and the validation figures.

Requires: gitea (book CI) · Scania ground truth

E4 — Supplier scorecard PDF export scripts/export_scorecard.py - Per-supplier PDF: evidence + risk flags + financial health + compliance - Status: NOT BUILT

G6 — Validate against Scania ground truth - What: compare the inferred tier-1/2 suppliers with a supplier list confirmed by Scania - Done when: precision/recall of inferred links is reported in the book - Status: NOT BUILT

Definition of done

SupplyLens is done for the Scania demo when:

  1. The Scania graph is seeded and the agent refreshes it weekly without manual steps (G1–G3)
  2. Every inferred supplier carries evidence and a confidence score (A1, B3 — done)
  3. Dashboards and the SupplyLens book show live data, not hard-coded examples (E3, G5)
  4. A supplier scorecard PDF can be handed to Scania (E4)
  5. The dry-run writes test-results/ JSON and passes, so the coordinator shows UC4 green (R1)

Risks & blockers

Risk / blocker Impact Mitigation
VPN routing broken (infra D-3) G1, G2, E5 cannot run on the cluster Fix on the VPN server (ip_forward, FORWARD chain); until then work on local artefacts
Kotaemon CT120 not provisioned Evidence RAG and citations stay synthetic E5 once VPN works
LiteLLM model routing changes (Groq key, embedding model) Inference step fails silently Keep dry-run step 5/7 in CI; alias ollama/nomic-embed-text
Superset loses DB session (PendingRollbackError) Dashboards error systemctl restart superset; health check in dry-run
Evidence is synthetic for part of the graph Demo credibility with Scania Label synthetic evidence in the UI; replace via Kotaemon ingest

Documentation & readiness

R1 — Dry-run writes JSON results - What: scripts/dry_run.sh writes test-results/dry_run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json with steps: [{name, status}] - Done when: the ResearchReady workbook shows UC4’s latest dry-run from the file, not from CLAUDE.md - Status: NOT BUILT

R2 — Colour-coded workflow - What: docs/workflow.yml describes every step with its status; rendered into the book and the workbook - Status: DONE ✅ (2026-09-28)

R3 — Complete plan - What: goal, status, definition of done, risks, readiness in this file - Status: DONE ✅ (2026-09-28)

R4 — Keep the book current - What: after each phase, update reports/06-status.qmd; CI (build-book.yml) publishes it - Done when: book status chapter matches this plan - Status: PARTIALLY BUILT (CI works; status chapter last updated before Phase 10)
